<!-- Per CONTRIBUTING.md: describe the PROBLEM first, not (yet) the exact
     wording change. Not a security vulnerability — those go to
     SECURITY.md, privately. -->

## Which document

Cite the specification and section, e.g. `ONP-1003` Section 4.5.

## The problem

What breaks, is ambiguous, or is missing without a change, and what is
the impact?

## Suggested direction (optional)

Any thoughts on a resolution. If this would change normative text, note
the likely versioning class (MAJOR / MINOR / PATCH) per
`specs/0007-versioning-policy.md`.

## Checklist

- [ ] I checked `specs/0002-terminology.md` for existing term ownership.
- [ ] I checked another single-owner document does not already cover this.
- [ ] This is **not** a security vulnerability (report those privately, see SECURITY.md).
